name: AC750 Dual-Band Wi-Fi Router TP-Link Archer C24 V2
summary: Archer C24 is a compact-designed Wi-Fi router for apartment / small home Wi-Fi user.
Its dual-band design brings high-speed anti-interference Wi-Fi to your home.
The minimalist design fits it easily into any kinds of decor.
